title: Laptop in a forest plate, whip in and out
summary: A laptop showing one landing page sits in a sunlit forest behind ferns. The camera whips in, drifts left for 3 s, whips out past a tree trunk, and the 5 s cycle runs twice. The page reads as a calm object in nature.
use_when: A brand with an outdoor, natural or wellness voice shows its landing page
A silent 10 s social loop around one hero screenshot
You have one strong page screenshot and no UI animation to show
An opener before a longer product walkthrough

look.type_style: no overlay type; the screen page carries a medium grotesk headline, sentence case, 2 lines, ~4 % of frame height

sfx.event: whip-in: camera swings onto the laptop (0.03 s, 5.00 s)
whip-out: laptop slides off left behind the trunk (4.00 s, 9.00 s)

structure.shot: one held frame: empty sunlit forest floor, mossy roots, conifers against a flat sky
structure.motion: none; single frame before the cut

structure.shot: whip across blurred undergrowth; laptop slides in from the right edge, screen on, base hidden in ferns
structure.camera: whip-pan to the left, ~880 px/s at 1920 averaged over the second, zoom -2.4 %/s, roll -2.8 deg/s; decelerates into the hold
structure.motion: laptop enters from the right rolled ~10 deg (±5), levels and settles by 1.00 s (±0.25 s), easings.outExpo ~27 fr (suggested); directional blur peaks 0.03-0.27 s

structure.shot: laptop at ~55 % frame width shows a landing page: nav, 2-line headline, small paragraph, 4 product cards, one button; ferns cover its lower edge
structure.camera: dolly left: 217 -> 36 -> 174 px/s (at 1920) in seconds 1, 2, 3; scale 1.00 -> ~1.01; laptop travels from right of centre to left of centre
structure.motion: speed-ramp: easings.inOutSine slow-down to a near hold at 2-3 s, then accelerates into the whip-out; laptop width constant within ±2 %

structure.shot: laptop tilts and slides off the left edge; a large mossy trunk crosses the foreground; lands on the empty forest frame
structure.camera: whip-pan left, 580 -> 880 px/s (at 1920), zoom -8.5 %/s, roll -3.8 deg/s; easings.inExpo into the blur
structure.motion: laptop rolls ~5-8 deg (±5) and exits by 4.77 s (±0.25 s); trunk wipes across 4.50-4.77 s; clean forest frame at 5.00 s matches 0.00 s

structure.shot: repeat of row 2: whip across undergrowth, laptop slides in from the right and settles
structure.camera: whip-pan left, ~880 px/s (at 1920), zoom -0.1 %/s, roll -2.1 deg/s
structure.motion: same as row 2, laptop settled by 6.00 s (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: repeat of row 3: the same page held on the laptop in the ferns
repeat of row 4: laptop slides off left behind the mossy trunk; film ends mid-whip
structure.camera: whip-pan left, 681 px/s (at 1920), zoom -5.7 %/s, roll -2.5 deg/s
structure.motion: same as row 4; last cell 9.77 s is the trunk mid-blur, so the film ends inside the motion

params.brand: any brand.json; colours only matter inside the page screenshot
params.content.screenshot: one landing-page screenshot, authored at 1512x982 for LaptopFrame screenContent
params.content.plate: a still or slow footage plate of a natural scene, wide enough for ~2.5 frame widths of lateral travel, plus a foreground foliage layer with alpha
params.timing.cycle: frames per whip-in/hold/whip-out cycle (default 150 = 5 s at 30 fps)

notes: One shot after a 1-frame opener: cuts.json lists only the cut at 0.03 s (frame 1). The film is a 5 s cycle played twice (sheet cells 5.00-9.77 repeat 0.00-4.77; motion.json seconds 5-9 repeat 0-4). The 5.00 s frame equals the 0.00 s frame, so a seamless loop works if the opener frame is dropped, but format.loopable stays false because the last cell (trunk mid-blur) does not match the first. Pan speeds and zoom come from motion.json (per-second averages at 1920 width); whip peaks, roll angles and the settle ease are not measurable at 4 fps (±0.25 s). Theme: keyframe mean luma 0.35-0.40, neither dark nor light by the rule; mixed = bright sky plate with a dark green page. Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not used as ids): plate-composite, foreground-occluder.
